phase: Phase 17-FE-P - external gravity prior and the gravity / K-variation degeneracy (linear, FE-L machinery)
written: 2026-10-15, after the prior construction and BEFORE any FE-P science output was computed

prior.GRAVITY_PRIOR_SOURCE: GL1800F per-coefficient uncertainty columns in the estimator's own coefficient file python_port/data/gravity/gl1800f/jggrx_1800f_sha.tab (PDS JGGRX_1800F_SHA, columns 5-6: uncertainty of C_nm, S_nm); parsed independently of the loader
prior.mapping: unambiguous: the estimator field IS GL1800F from the same file - fully normalised, R = 1738 km, GM 4902.8003063302 km3/s2, DE440 principal axes (MOON_PA_DE440), degree-2/3 coefficients without the permanent tide; the FE corrections dC_nm, dS_nm are in exactly this normalisation
prior.GRAVITY_PRIOR_SEMANTICS: zero-mean Gaussian prior on the FE corrections dC_nm, dS_nm (centre = the GL1800F value the estimator already uses); the label does not state whether the uncertainties are formal or calibrated - treated as the published per-coefficient uncertainty
prior.PRIOR_COVARIANCE_FORM: diagonal (no GL1800F coefficient covariance is available in the repository) - labelled APPROXIMATION
prior.PRIMARY_PRIOR_SCALE: x1 (the published sigmas as they are)
prior.PRIOR_SENSITIVITY_SET: x10, x100 (robustness variants for possible optimism of published sigmas; chosen before any FE-P output; they do not change the primary outcome)
prior.secondary_stress_scale: sigma_nm = |dC_nm(GRGM1200L - GL1800F)| (and dS), labelled STRESS / bracketing only - it is the controlled mismatch direction itself, not an uncertainty
prior.construction_fact_recorded_before_scorin: the MM mismatch GRGM1200L - GL1800F (rescaled to GL mu/R) at degrees 2-6 is |dC|/sigma_GL1800F = median 5696, min 82.9 (S22), max 65362: the controlled mismatch lies far outside GL1800F's published uncertainty

design.cells: the 10 KP2 / FE-L cells, HIGH_FIDELITY, the FE-L design (x0 + a priori, M3 K, free per-pass Doppler bias, range 5 m, Doppler 1e-4 m/s)
design.prior_rows: one whitened row per FE coefficient: 1/sigma_nm on that column, right-hand side 0; nothing else changed
design.mismatch_primary: alpha (GRGM1200L - GL1800F) at degree 50, alpha in {0.3, 1} (the MM/FE-L construction)
design.configs_scored: N in {4, 6} x prior {x1 primary, x10, x100} + stress {|dC|} (secondary)

metrics.fv_chi2: linear false-variation chi2 (2 dof) of the mismatch, posterior variation covariance of the regularised design
metrics.resid_chi2: unabsorbed mismatch chi2 in the DATA rows only (prior-row penalty reported separately)
metrics.diagnostics: sigma_v, field-parameter posterior sigma / prior sigma (information gain), max |corr(K variation, field)|

secondary_diagnostic_prior_consistent_er: PRIOR_CONSISTENT_MASQUERADE_RISK: 20 seeded draws per scale x1, x10, x100 of a random field error dC_nm, dS_nm ~ N(0, (scale sigma_nm)^2) over degrees 2..50 (seed [cell, scale_index, draw]); false-variation chi2 under the standard fixed-field KP2 design (N = 0) and under the primary FE-P configs; reported as median / max / fraction >= 13.82. Not part of the classification

classification.cell_resolved(cfg): fv_chi2 < 13.82 for alpha = 0.3 and 1 AND noncentrality >= 13.82 for every truth that is eligible in that cell (FE-L N = 0 eligibility: noncentrality(N=0) >= 13.82)
classification.SUPPRESSES(cfg): fv_chi2 < 13.82 for both alpha in all 10 cells
rule (on the PRIMARY scale x1, N in {4,: FE_PRIOR_INCONCLUSIVE if any validation gate P1-P5 fails
FE_PRIOR_RESOLVES_DEGENERACY if some N has SUPPRESSES and PRESERVES
FE_PRIOR_SUPPRESSES_BUT_COSTS_VARIATION if some N has SUPPRESSES (but not PRESERVES)
FE_PRIOR_PARTIALLY_RESOLVES_DEGENERACY if some N resolves >= 5 of the 10 cells
classification.sensitivity_and_stress: classified with the same rule and reported; they never replace the primary outcome

gates.P1_normal_equations: for one cell and N = 6: (A^T A) of the regularised whitened design equals the independently assembled data information + diag(1/sigma^2) on the FE block, <= 1e-10 relative
gates.P2_weak_limit: prior sigma x 1e8: every fv_chi2 / noncentrality reproduces the FE-L data-only value of the same N within 1e-6 relative (or 1e-6 absolute below 1)
gates.P3_strong_limit: prior sigma x 1e-8: reproduces N = 0 within 1e-6 relative (or 1e-6 absolute below 1)
gates.P4_sigma_mapping: the sigma vector in coefficient order equals an independent re-parse of the .tab lines (exact), spot values C20 4.593682635805e-12, C21 1.303864780869e-12, S21 1.390771628190e-12
gates.P5_FE_L_reproduction: with no prior, the recomputed designs reproduce the committed FE-L cell metrics (fv_chi2, noncentrality) within 1e-8 relative

nonlinear_confirmation: only if the primary outcome is FE_PRIOR_RESOLVES_DEGENERACY
not_claimed: that GRGM1200L - GL1800F is a realistic gravity uncertainty
formal-sigma reduction as evidence of separability
